text:
Maya R: kicking off a quick quant pilot on dev-stg for 'cicero-small' (int8). running a small sanity + regression sweep now. checklist coming inline — will post failures here. ETA ~30m.

Maya R: ```
- model: cicero-small:v1-int8
- qconfig: awq, per-channel
- kv_cache: enabled
- seq_len: 512 (initial)
- prompts: core-smoke-20.json (qa + few instruction)
- metrics: exact_match, token_diff, latency
- env: dev-stg cluster b (gpu-pool-3)
```

Ajay K: noted. are we running with the same tokenizer as baseline (bpe vs bpe-fast)? kv cache edge cases vary.

Maya R: seq_len=512 and using default tokenizer from model card (bpe). repro curl if you want to run locally: ```curl -X POST https://devstg.api.redwood/model/infer -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"cicero-small:v1-int8","prompt":"What's the capital of France?","max_tokens":32}'```

Liam: quick flag — saw a tokenization/decoding diff on that exact prompt: baseline -> "Paris" but int8 -> "París" (accent). looks like detokenizer or unicode normalization drift.

Maya R: good catch. sample outputs below: ```
baseline: Paris
int8: París
```

Maya R: also saw one truncation on a longer multi-step QA (answer cut mid-sentence). logging the sample below and pushing to logs.

eval-bot: smoke run finished. summary: 20 prompts, 2 regressions flagged (tokenization accent, truncated_answer). avg latency 340ms, p50 120ms, p95 610ms. token_diff metric flagged ~0.8% of tokens altered. full json report uploaded to /artifacts/cicero-int8/2632109876/report.json

Dawn (oncall): please add a targeted regression test for the accent case to ci-llm-smoke and open a ticket so QE can follow up. also tag infra if KV cache repros. :eyes:

Ajay K: created ticket Q-1523 with repro + samples: https://redwood.prod/issue/Q-1523

Maya R: quick mitigation: switching tokenizer to 'bpe-fast' and rerunning now (will note if latency changes).

smokebot: rerun started by Maya R on cicero-small:v1-int8 (run id 2632109885)

smokebot: rerun complete — regressions cleared (tokenization fixed), one truncation gone after adjusting max_context. latency increased ~+10ms p50. :thumbsup:

Maya R: thanks team — will open PR to change tokenizer in dev-stg config and add the regression test to ci. keeping this thread as the single place for logs/artifacts.

Liam: ack, will follow up with a short exploit to test unicode normalization.

Maya R: tagging for visibility: @Ajay K @Dawn (oncall) @Liam. final artifacts: /artifacts/cicero-int8/2632109876/ (report.json, samples.log, config.diff)
